item.title: Train Dreams Editor Parker Laramie on Cutting the Oscar Contender
item.description: Clint Bentley's Train Dreams was one of the standout films at last year's Sundance and is currently up for four Oscars. Editor Parker Laramie discusses how the movie came together at his house in LA. "We’d hop online every morning, and cut until it was time to put the kids to bed."

item.title: Super 35 and APS-C: The camera sensor history you need to know
item.description: Replay: The sensor size we call Super 35 has roots going back to the 19th century, but why is it super and is it the same as APS-C?

item.title: ARRI x Honor Robot Phone & Leica Leitzphone at MWC 2026
item.description: The attention turns to smartphones with the start of MWC Barcelona today. ARRI has a surprising new collab with Honor while Leica's new Leitzphone has been produced with Xiaomi.

item.title: Accsoon CineView SE 4K: 4K wireless video transmission and camera control for $499
item.description: Accsoon has announced the CineView SE 4K, an evolution of its popular CineView SE wireless video transmission system that adds 4K resolution, H.265 encoding, wireless camera control, and a new USB-C video output.

item.title: Apple iPhone 17e: A19 chip, 48 MP camera, MagSafe — $599
item.description: Apple has announced the iPhone 17e, a more affordable addition to its iPhone 17 lineup, starting at $599 for 256 GB of storage — double the entry storage of the previous generation at the same price.

item.title: Apple iPad Air M4 (2026): Specs, price, and what's new
item.description: Apple's popular iPad Air steps up to the M4 chip, 12 GB of memory, Wi-Fi 7, and a faster modem — in both 11-inch and 13-inch sizes from $599.

item.title: Beeble SwitchX review: AI-powered VFX relighting and background replacement
item.description: Beeble’s new SwitchX uses generative video to change the lighting, background, props, costumes, and on-screen world of a video, while keeping the subject consistent, recognizable, and intact.

item.title: Foundry Nuke 17.0: Gaussian Splats, USD 3D system and BigCat ML
item.description: Foundry's latest Nuke 17.0 release brings Gaussian Splat workflows, a USD-based 3D system out of beta, and large-scale machine learning tools to compositing artists.

item.title: Apple Studio Display and Studio Display XDR: two displays, two very different missions
item.description: Apple has announced two new displays aimed at different ends of the professional market. The updated Studio Display brings incremental but welcome upgrades, while the all-new Studio Display XDR replaces the now discontinued Pro Display XDR.

item.title: Apple Studio Display vs Studio Display XDR: Specs compared
item.description: Apple's two new displays have a lot of similarities over and above the form factor. These are the differences between the two alongside an important caveat about 120 Hz support.
